PRIM-001 / Delivery stream control / B01 v1
Every option offers the same destinations and core journeys. The 3D options differ in visual detail. Quick Access presents the journey without a 3D scene.

Selecting an option does not change your experience. Apply selection re-enters the experience only when you choose a different option, keeping your current location where available. If that location has no match, you will arrive at the nearest available parent destination and be told where you are. Applying the current option makes no change.
